provenance: Derived from pot_all failures where reasoning was descriptive but code printed df.head(), Series, counts, or rows.

semantic_labels.label: output.no_dataframe_print
semantic_labels.description: Prevent printing intermediate dataframe inspection artifacts as final answers.

scope.observed_error: descriptive prompts printed dataframe artifacts instead of narrative answer

payload.content: Print only the final requested answer string or value. Do not print `df`, `df.head()`, `describe()`, Series, counts, debug rows, or any intermediate inspection output.

rationale: Targets DescriptiveAnalysis and other code-mode failures where the model reasoned correctly but printed dataframe diagnostics.
